# langsmith_tag_key (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a LangSmith tag key by ID or key name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_tag_key" "example" {
  key = "environment"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique identifier. Either `id` or `key` must be specified.
- `key` (String) The tag key name. Either `id` or `key` must be specified.
- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) A description of the tag key.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
